subject: Intrinsic functions
notes: kb/Work PB73 (adjudicated 2026-08-18): a NUMERIC function is class and category numeric with an operational sign and 'may be used anywhere a sending data item of that class and category may be specified' — as a MOVE sender it is Table 16's NONINTEGER numeric row (item 4 says nothing about digits right of the decimal point; §8.4.3.2.3 SR11 states the principle), so it moves only to a numeric / numeric-edited receiver: COBOL0819 into alphanumeric / national / boolean / alphabetic, a warning + the item-92 literal text under --permissive. Before this every function carried IsNonInteger: false (an under-rejection).
